name: OS Computer Use
description: Approval-gated OS-level computer use over a platform adapter port: bounded screen capture, window listing and one-action coordinate/key/text input with an evidence journal. Explicitly unavailable on platforms without a wired adapter.

features.name: 受审批约束的整屏与窗口截图（内存 PNG 证据）
features.nameEn: Approval-gated full-screen and window capture (in-memory PNG evidence)

features.name: 单步坐标点击、滚动、按键与文本输入，无自由脚本
features.nameEn: One-action coordinate click, scroll, key and text input; no free-form scripting

features.name: 窗口列表、聚焦与窗口内坐标换算
features.nameEn: Window listing, focus and window-relative coordinate mapping

features.name: 会话级 screen/input 授权账本，可撤销并持久化
features.nameEn: Per-session screen/input grant ledger, revocable and persisted

features.name: 平台适配端口；无适配器的平台明确不可用
features.nameEn: Platform adaptation port; explicitly unavailable without an adapter

features.name: 每次交互的证据日志（动作、目标、时间与序号）
features.nameEn: Evidence journal for every interaction (action, target, time and sequence)
